title: Thitriset(Rusted Meat)
description: 🥩 Rusted Meat: A unique food that provides long-lasting saturation. | Thịt Rỉ Sét: Loại thực phẩm độc đáo giúp bạn no lâu hơn.
body:
🥩 RUSTED MEAT: END HUNGER PERMANENTLY 🥩
Are you tired of being constantly interrupted by a shrinking food bar? Frustrated that just a few steps after eating a full steak, you're already hungry again? It seems Vanilla food sources are just too weak for the demands of a true Minecraft warrior.

Fear not, Rusted Meat has arrived to save your stomach!

💡 THE INSPIRATION
Born from the nightmare of "starving to death" in the middle of a major construction project or while facing down a Boss, Rusted Meat was created as a source of super-compressed energy. It allows you to maintain your peak stamina for many times longer than normal.

🛠 CRAFTING RITUAL (QUICK CRAFT)
No fancy ovens or crafting tables required! You can craft Rusted Meat right in the field by dropping the following items on the ground:

🥩 Cooked Beef: Any amount (You will receive one Rusted Meat for every Cooked Beef dropped).

⚙️ 1 Iron Nugget: The essential catalyst needed to create the energy-packed "rusted" layer.

In the blink of an eye, your ordinary beef will be "ironized," transforming into the most durable food item you have ever seen!

🔥 GOD-TIER SATURATION EFFECT
Why is it called the "King of Meats"? Because of its incredible effect:

Instant Saturation Buff: The moment you eat it, you receive an intensely powerful Saturation effect that lasts for a full 60 seconds.

What it does: For one entire minute, your food bar will not decrease, no matter how much you run, jump, or fight. It’s like having a constant, direct supply of energy delivered straight to your bloodstream!
